purpose: Equal-time development diagnostic after a frozen hybrid screen; cannot reverse a rejected fresh test or satisfy formal admission.
schedule: Opening order 0..99; even openings hybrid then expanded and white then black; odd openings expanded then hybrid and black then white.
scoreAnalysisRequires: Complete 400-game inventory; hashes verified; independent legal replay, repetition history, termination and search metadata audit.
statistics: Descriptive candidate score and one-sided 95% t lower bound over 100 paired-opening means, separately per arm. No repeated seed slots. The exposed opening bank and short time control preclude formal generalization or shipping claims.
termination: Engine gameStatus rules including full-prefix repetition history, otherwise draw at 180 searched plies; no evaluator-score adjudication.
